ground_truth.title: Multi-stage Dockerfile contains duplicate stage aliases
ground_truth.rationale: Multi-stage Docker builds should use unique aliases for each build stage. Duplicate aliases create ambiguity and can make stage references difficult to understand or maintain correctly.
